title: Mixed 2: implement from spec
prompt:
No topic given. A 'plateau' is a run of two or more equal adjacent values. Count the plateaus in the array (a run of 4 equal values counts as ONE plateau; separate runs count separately). Implement `process(int[] arr)` (0 when no plateau exists).

Example: `{1,1,2,2,2,3}` → `2`; `{1,2,3}` → `0`.

tests.name: plateau count
tests.hint: Count run STARTS: arr[i] == arr[i-1] && (i == 1 || arr[i-1] != arr[i-2]).
